facts.fact: StackAdapt says it was the first self-serve DSP to make LiveRamp's RampID Retrieval API directly accessible to users.
facts.quote: We are the first self-serve DSP to make LiveRamp’s RampID Retrieval API directly accessible for users.

facts.fact: StackAdapt states that with its near real-time CRM upload integration, a new targeting segment can be created in approximately 30 minutes.
facts.quote: With this integration, you can create a new targeting segment in approximately 30 minutes.

facts.fact: StackAdapt states that its Audience Lookalike Expansion targeting can increase conversions by up to 2X.
facts.quote: By targeting similar audiences, you can increase your conversions by up to 2X.

facts.fact: StackAdapt introduced Performance-Based Budget Allocation, which dynamically allocates budget across campaign groups based on campaign CPA performance.
facts.quote: allowing you to set up campaign groups to dynamically allocate budget based on campaign CPA performance.

facts.fact: StackAdapt reporting allows assigning a revenue value to a conversion event, either as a static value or dynamically tracking order values, to report on ROAS and conversion revenue.
facts.quote: you can now assign a revenue value to a conversion event, either defining a static value or tracking order values dynamically.

facts.fact: StackAdapt added a Funnel.io integration in 2020 that lets Funnel automatically ingest StackAdapt campaign data.
facts.quote: This integration enables Funnel to automatically ingest campaign data from StackAdapt

facts.fact: StackAdapt data can be sent to NinjaCat via NinjaCat's Smart Connector, as announced in 2020.
facts.quote: Marketers can now sendStackAdapt data to NinjaCat via their Smart Connector.
